rows.label: tlk43300241_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm from a minor noble family, so I
traveled across Alst with my parents.

rows.label: tlk43300241_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Even then, Superbia's Divine Beast was
already nearing the end of its life.

rows.label: tlk43300241_02_msg0004
rows.name:
As a Divine Beast nears death, its
surface heats up, plants wither, and
the ground is laid bare...

rows.label: tlk43300241_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I wouldn't want to live in a place
like that.

rows.label: tlk43300241_02_msg0006
rows.name:
Invidia really is the finest
Divine Beast.
